versions.notes: Initial setup - VSCode 1.136.1 with built-in Copilot integration

Version bump 1.136.1 → 1.139.1. New features detected: GitHub Agentic Workflows (public preview), dynamic workflows, Copilot CLI /fleet parallel execution, /research command, BYOK support, code review agentic capabilities, CLI extensions, computer use in CLI.

Version bump 1.139.1 -> 1.142.0 (released 2026-10-14). New features: Copilot harness (Copilot SDK, Agent Host, progressive default rollout, background sessions across editor + Agents window), Canvases preview (interactive collaboration surfaces, /create-canvas), move chats between folders/worktrees, agent sandboxing + enterprise permission policies (managed settings, per-mode permission controls), redesigned model picker (Copilot + BYOK, effort levels, context windows), Markdown editor improvements.

Version bump 1.142.0 -> 1.143.1 (stable released 2026-10-28). New features: Copilot harness now default for new sessions; model comparisons (Agent Bake-Off, Preview) on by default in the Agents window; on-device models (MAI Code 1.1 Flash, Experimental, llama.cpp); worktree storage cleanup for inactive agent sessions (Experimental); multi-diff editor file list (Experimental); BYOK OpenAI Live model for Voice Mode (Preview); sandbox CA certificate trust management (Sandbox: Manage Trusted CA) and per-session sandboxing toggle when policy permits bypass; enterprise managed model defaults, OTel telemetry.headersProvider dynamic headers, auto-installed managed plugins, Local harness retirement controls. Next stable 1.144.0 (released 2026-10-28) already announced: cloud sessions, Copilot Fusion, image generation in chat, computer use, cloud automations, AHP v1.0.

Version bump 1.143.1 -> 1.144.0 (stable released 2026-10-28). New features: GitHub Copilot Fusion (GA) - automatic model routing and multi-model orchestration in the model picker, effort levels Standard/High/Max, High/Max on Business & Enterprise plans, 30% discount through 2026-11-30; cloud sessions (Copilot tasks on GitHub-managed compute from the Agents window or Chat view, requires paid plan, org policies apply, chat.agentHost.cloudSandbox.enabled); Cloud automations (Preview) - scheduled and event-triggered (issue/PR) cloud runs created in the Agents window; Agent Host Protocol v1.0 published (open, extensible protocol; websocket remote agent host via 'Agents: Add Remote Agent Host...'; libraries in 6 languages); image generation in Copilot chat (Preview, GPT Image 2.5 Flare, uses AI credits, watermark setting); Computer Use (Experimental, /computer on|off, macOS/Windows only); working set for reviewing Copilot harness file edits (Experimental, chat.editor.workingSet.enabled, Keep/Undo in editor); assisted permissions GA (LLM risk assessment auto-approves low-risk tool calls, requires Folder isolation, may be org-restricted); Remote Environments dialog (GitHub Environments, Dev Tunnels, WSL, SSH hosts in one manager); Copilot Memory now available in Copilot harness sessions (cloud memory: repository facts + user preferences); model comparisons expanded (folderless chat, local/empty repositories); Local-to-Copilot harness transition guide. Next stable 1.145 (released 2026-11-04): browse over remote agent host connections (Preview), remote canvases (Preview), mixed-harness nested sessions (Preview), cron schedules for local automations, agent verbosity control, pinned canvases, Blobby jump game (Experimental).
